newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Pilot killed in S.African helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Pilot killed in S.African helicopter crash.

text.p: A helicopter pilot was killed and a passenger seriously injured when their aircraft crashed near Johannesburg on Friday, South African police said.
"They were the only two people in the helicopter. It crashed into an open field so nobody else was injured on the ground," police Superintendent Eugene Opperman told Reuters.
It was not immediatelyknown what caused the craft, which was apparently being used for municipal business, to go down in Midrand, about 20 km (12 miles) north of Johannesburg.
